headline: Schneider Electric in advanced talks to acquire software maker PTC for $20 billion
hook: France's Schneider eyes its biggest deal ever
summary: French industrial conglomerate Schneider Electric is nearing a roughly $20 billion agreement to buy US software group PTC. The proposed transaction would mark the largest acquisition in Schneider's history, significantly expanding its digital and industrial software offerings for manufacturers. PTC develops computer-aided design and product lifecycle management software used globally. For Indian retail investors, large cross-border industrial software consolidation can influence global tech spending trends and shape the competitive landscape for automation services.
why_it_matters: Global industrial tech consolidation shapes enterprise software pricing and demand.
winners_losers: PTC shareholders gain / software competitors challenged
